result.summary: The environment is a residential street with continuous sidewalks and a marked crosswalk at the intersection. However, the wide roadway and presence of parked cars near the corner create visibility issues and may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near intersection
hazards.description: Parked cars on the side street and main road near the corner obstruct sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Wide roadway
hazards.description: The wide, straight travel lanes may encourage vehicle speeds higher than appropriate for a residential area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by extending the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse markings with continental markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals, forcing people to cross an uncontrolled roadway without designated protection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to their presence.

hazards.name: Inaccessible curbs
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the crossing difficult or impossible for users with mobility devices.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add ladder or zebra-style markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Add ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the corner to ensure accessibility.
